method: Each occupation's O*NET OnLine summary page and, where one exists and opened, its BLS Occupational Outlook Handbook (OOH) page were opened by research agents on 2026-10-13. The pages were read through a summarising fetch tool, so figures are second-hand: spot-check any figure before it is quoted. No BLS OEWS occupation page returned data (all showed only the generic tables index), and several OOH pages returned HTTP 403, so those fields are blank, never filled from memory.

rows.title: Electricians
rows.brightWhy: growth much faster than average (7% or higher)
rows.note: O*NET shows 72,700 openings for 2025-2035; the OOH calls the same figure annual.

rows.title: Helpers--Electricians
rows.brightWhy: growth slower than average (1% to 2%)
rows.note: No OOH page of its own. The PRD said about 85,000; the O*NET page shows 65,000. O*NET's openings unit (annual or decade) is unconfirmed.

rows.title: Construction and Building Inspectors
rows.brightWhy: little or no projected change
rows.note: The PRD said about 106,000; O*NET and the OOH both show 153,900.

rows.title: Solar Photovoltaic Installers
rows.brightWhy: growth much faster than average (7% or higher)
rows.note: The PRD said about 22,000; both pages show 31,100.

rows.title: Security and Fire Alarm Systems Installers
rows.brightWhy: growth much faster than average (7% or higher)
rows.note: The OOH page did not open (HTTP 403) and a search found no OOH page for this occupation. Also listed in the market document's adjacent group, so it is counted once.
